params.description: List of parameters which can be used in the filter condition plugin

block_pins.description: Pin numbers of the pin block.

enabled.description: Check to enable this Data to Server.

wait.description: Specifies what is the shortest amount of seconds between triggers. Trigger interval and action's Execution delay values are summed up when calculating total interval between triggers.

actions.description: Array of action IDs associated with the event.

available_conditions.description: Array of available condition IDs that can be used in the 'conditions' option for action section.

astro_trigger.description: Astronomical event that will trigger the action.

astro_latitude.description: Latitude for the Astro Time event.

astro_longitude.description: Longitude for the Astro Time event.

astro_type.description: Select the type of astronomical event calculation to use: Official - standard time used by most people, Civil - Used for general purposes, Nautical - Used by sailors Astronomical- Used by astronomers.

boot_mode.description: Boot event that will trigger the action.

gps_trigger.description: GPS event that will trigger the action.

gps_radius.description: Radius for the GPS event in meters.

gps_altitude.description: Altitude for the GPS event in meters.

gps_speed.description: Speed for the GPS event in km/h.

gsm_modem_id.description: Modem to use for GSM event.

gsm_event.description: GSM event that will trigger the action.

gsm_signal_trigger.description: Signal strength condition that will trigger the event.

gsm_signal_range.description: Signal strength range in dBm. First value is the lower limit and the second value is the upper limit. Separate values with a comma.

hotspot_trigger.description: Hotspot event that will trigger the action.

io_name.description: Specifies the I/O to which the event is listening to.

io_trigger.description: Specifies the condition that will trigger the event.

io_reset.description: Prevents execution of actions if the I/O returns to its normal state before the action delay time has elapsed.

io_inside.description: Range for I/O event: 1 - within the range, 0 - outside the range.

io_min.description: Specifies minimum voltage/current/percent value of analog pin.

io_max.description: Specifies maximum voltage/current/percent value of analog pin.

log_event.description: Type of event that will trigger the action.

log_event_mark.description: More specific subtype of the event that will trigger the action.

quota_interface.description: Network interface which will trigger the event.

time_month.description: Month in which the event will trigger.

time_day_type.description: Allows selecting between week and month days for instance intervals.

time_day.description: Month days when the action should be triggered. If nothing is selected, every day of the month will be included.

time_weekday.description: Weekdays when the action should be triggered. If nothing is selected, every day of the week will be included.

time_hour.description: Hours when the event should be triggered. If nothing is selected, every hour will be included.

time_minute.description: Minutes when the event should be triggered. If nothing is selected, every minute will be included.

time_month_override.description: Forces intervals to accept last day of month as valid option if selected day doesn't exist in ongoing month.

delay.description: How many seconds will pass before the action is executed after it's triggered.

retry_count.description: Retry sending the same data the configured number of times upon failure.

retry_timeout.description: Timeout in seconds between action retry attempts.

operator.description: Defines the logical operator used to combine multiple conditions. Choose from 'and', 'or', 'nor', or 'nand' to specify how conditions should be evaluated together.

conditions.description: Array of action condition IDs that must be met for the action to be allowed.

conn_type.description: Type of connection this configuration applies to.

conn_state.description: Enables or disables the connection. Disabling will stop the network interface or modem connection.

conn_persist.description: If enabled, the connection state will be maintained even after a system restart or power cycle.

conn_modem_id.description: Modem to be used for this connection.

conn_sim.description: SIM card to be used for this connection.

exec_arg_type.description: Choose how to send arguments: as text or key-value pairs.

exec_arguments.description: Arguments to be sent to the script as text.

exec_arg.description: Arguments to be sent to the script as key-value pairs..

exec_file_type.description: Choose whether to upload a file directly or specify a file path.

exec_info_modem_id.description: Choose the modem whose ID will be passed to the script.

http_post.description: HTTP method to use for the request.

http_url.description: Destination host URL where data will be sent.

http_header.description: Custom headers for the HTTP requests.

http_timeout.description: Timeout for the request in seconds.

http_tls.description: Enables TLS for a secure connection. Requires certificate files.

http_cafile.description: Certificate Authority (CA) file. Required for verifying the server's certificate.

http_certfile.description: Client certificate file. This is used for client authentication by the server.

http_keyfile.description: Client private key file. This is used along with the client certificate for authentication.

http_verify.description: Verifies the validity of certificates, only works with HTTPS.

http_ui_params.description: Choose how to send parameters with the request. 0 - text, 1 - key-value pairs.

http_text.description: Parameters to be sent with the request as text.

http_params.description: Parameters to be sent with the request as key-value pairs.

lua_action_path.description: Path to the Lua script file.

modem_action.description: Action which will be performed on the modem.

mqtt_topic.description: MQTT topic used for publishing the data.

mqtt_text.description: Text parameters to be sent with the message.

mqtt_qos.description: Quality of Service level for the message.

mqtt_keepalive.description: The number of seconds after which the broker should send a PING message to the client if no other messages have been exchanged in that time.

mqtt_client_id.description: Client ID to send with the data. If empty, a random client ID will be generated.

mqtt_use_credentials.description: Uses a username and password for for MQTT authentication.

mqtt_password:set.description: Value displayed when user doesn't have permissions to see sensitive information.

mqtt_tls.description: Enables TLS for a secure connection. Requires certificate files.

mqtt_device_files.description: Enable to use certificate files stored on the device.

mqtt_cafile.description: Certificate Authority (CA) file. Required for verifying the server's certificate.

mqtt_certfile.description: Client certificate file. This is used for client authentication by the server.

mqtt_keyfile.description: Client private key file. This is used along with the client certificate for authentication.

mqtt_psk.description: The pre-shared key in hex format with no leading “0x”.

mqtt_psk:set.description: Value displayed when user doesn't have permissions to see sensitive information.

mqtt_info_modem_id.description: Modem used to gather information from.

out_mode.description: Control mode for the selected output.

out_dest.description: Output or relay whose state will be changed.

out_copy.description: Copies the state from selected input to selected output.

out_state.description: Sets the output state to active.

out_revert.description: Number of seconds after which the state will revert. If set to 0 or left empty, the state will not revert.

out_maintain.description: Maintain the current IO state after a reboot.

profile.description: Name of the profile to be applied.

rms_on.description: Turns the RMS state on or off.

sim_modem_id.description: Modem to be used for SIM switch.

sim_flip.description: Switches to a different inserted SIM card.

sim_number.description: SIM card to be switched to.

sim_write.description: Set the SIM as default after switching.

sms_text.description: Text parameters to be sent with the message.

sms_modem_id.description: Modem used to send the SMS message.

sms_info_modem_id.description: Modem used to gather information from.

sms_recipient_format.description: Choose whether to add a single phone number or use a phone group list.

sms_phone.description: Phone number to which the SMS message will be sent.

sms_group.description: Phone group to which the SMS message will be sent.

call_phone.description: Phone number to which the call will be made.

call_timeout.description: Specify the timeout for the call in seconds. After this time, the call will be automatically ended (the receiver will be hung up).

call_modem_id.description: Modem used to make the call.

smtp_text.description: Text parameters to be sent with the email.

wifi_on.description: Turns the WiFi state on or off.

led_revert.description: Specifies the time in seconds after which the LED state automatically reverts to the previous state. If this option is unset, the LED state will not revert.

led_blink_on.description: Specifies the time in milliseconds that the LED remains on during blinking.

led_blink_off.description: Specifies the time in milliseconds that the LED remains off during blinking.

bool_operation.description: Operation to be performed on the conditions.

bool_not.description: Invert the evaluation results of the boolean group.

bool_conditions.description: List of conditions that will be evaluated.

filter_name.description: Name of the data field to be filtered.

filter_value.description: Value that should be compared against the data field.

filter_operator.description: Operator to be used for filtering the data field.

gps_cond_event.description: Event type for the GPS condition: in - for entering the area, out - for leaving the area.

gps_cond_radius.description: Radius for the GPS condition in meters.

io_cond_name.description: Specifies the I/O to which the condition is listening to.

io_cond_state.description: Specifies in what state the pin has to be.

io_cond_not.description: Range for I/O condition: 0 - within the range, 1 - outside the range.

io_cond_acl.description: Specifies the ACL value to which the condition is listening to.

io_cond_min.description: Specifies minimum voltage/current/percent value of analog pin.

io_cond_max.description: Specifies maximum voltage/current/percent value of analog pin.

time_cond_day_type.description: Allows selecting between week, month and year days for instance intervals.

time_cond_wday.description: Weekdays when the action should be triggered. If nothing is selected, every day of the week will be included.

time_cond_day.description: Month days when the action should be triggered. If nothing is selected, every day of the month will be included.

time_cond_month_override.description: Forces intervals to accept last day of month as valid option if selected day doesn't exist in ongoing month.

time_cond_start_yday.description: Start day number of the year for the interval when the action should be triggered.

time_cond_end_yday.description: End day number of the year for the interval when the action should be triggered.

time_cond_start_time.description: Enter the start time in hh:mm format to set when the action should be triggered. Use the 24-hour format (00:00 - 23:59). Accepted formats include hh:mm or *:mm, where * serves as a wildcard for any hour.

time_cond_end_time.description: Enter the end time in hh:mm format to set when the action should be triggered. Use the 24-hour format (00:00 - 23:59). Accepted formats include hh:mm or *:mm, where * serves as a wildcard for any hour.
